title: OVERWATCH-ADVERSARIAL — matrix pair #10 (qwen3.8-27b -> gemini-3.5-flash), UNPROVEN (no live cell): the rs_* ride class on a family-UNSET target. Seed = the byte-pinned vlq-vlg qwen phase (11 recs, 2 rs_* reasoning ids, no encryption); ACP mid-session switch to gemini-3.5-flash (config.toml carries NO model_family -> family UNSET). Code-derivable era state (re-verified 2026-09-18, xw-vlq-vlg-ws first-hand): on the cell's original flip (qwen->glm-5.2) the seed marker text rode into the glm request (1 hit/req) while the 2 rs_* reasoning items did NOT ride (glm requests carried messages only) — the glm precedent is the prediction anchor; gemini (vertex openai-responses compat via litellm) is a DIFFERENT target class, never live-exercised. Not a family switch (target family unset) => NO preemptive compact. expected_red: NONE at case level (the engine's expected_red is case-level binary — FAIL -> RED-EXPECTED(id) — and a .71 registration would MASK the primary apex-ayl.90 serialization death, so this case intentionally carries none). ERRATUM 2026-09-19 (sibling flag, adjudicated by coordinator): the pre-.71 premise 'a storage-form RED at switch = a NEW finding' is ERA-STALE — the observed storage first_diff_index=2 (type=reasoning) diff is the documented apex-ayl.71 projector rekey class (rs_6a4c8e2f -> xw_f5c9ceda469a2d2a5bbdd85f; signatures.json row #11; first-hand verified in the 20260919T084258Z sweep). REFINED STOP RULE: a storage-form RED at switch OF A NON-.71-REKEY CLASS = a NEW finding -> STOP; the .71-rekey idx2 diff is documented, not STOP-worthy. The vlq-vlg cell golden re-pin was MISSING from the .70 re-pin spec (that spec covered az-vlq + vxm-* cells only) — owed to the .71 lane. PREDICTED: count-1 shape; rs_* ids ABSENT from every gemini request (glm-precedent prediction); final 200. STOP-AND-REPORT (house rule): a 400/503 final with a phrasing outside F1-F5 + triage #13-17, an rs_* id PRESENT on a gemini request (200 = tolerance record -> matrix note; 400/503 = new ride class), a STORAGE-DIFF RED at switch (a NEW finding for a qwen seed — this case carries no expected_red), a count outside 1..4 (storm), or an acp_error.
